entities.summary: The Michelin Guide is a restaurant guide that has been published by the French tire company Michelin since 1900. It awards up to three Michelin stars for excellence to a select few restaurants in certain geographic areas. Michelin also publishes the Green Guides, a series of general guides to cities, regions, and countries.
